notes: VAT 10% on physical bars/coins and jewellery; KRX trades VAT-free, 10% on withdrawal (Korea Customs release). Duty 3% basic/MFN (Customs; UNI-PASS HS 7108.13); 0% is FTA-origin only. Buyback 1.8% and used 3.8% are Korea Gold Exchange prices vs own sell price, VAT-excl., 27 Nov 2026; VAT-inclusive retail spread about 14%. Making (segongbi) % removed in round 1 (calculator-site support).
